item.title: Senior Backend Engineer
item.description:
Render is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to help build the future of cloud infrastructure. We're a fast-growing startup powering modern web apps.

Location: San Francisco, CA (or Remote)

What you'll do:

  • Design and build reliable, scalable backend systems
  • Work on deployment pipelines and container orchestration
  • Collaborate with a small, high-impact engineering team

Requirements:

  • 4+ years of backend engineering experience
  • Proficiency in Go or Rust
  • Experience with Kubernetes
